problem: Small community groups (HOAs, clubs, hobby circles) need a simple way to announce one‑off events, collect RSVPs, manage waitlists and share details without paying for complex ticketing platforms or relying on fragmented group chats.
solution: A lightweight, mobile‑responsive static website that lets organizers create an event page, set a capacity, and lets visitors RSVP instantly. Data is stored locally in the browser (localStorage) so the site works fully offline and costs nothing to host.

competitors.name: Eventbrite
competitors.difference: Heavy feature set, fees per ticket, requires account; our tool is free, zero‑fee, no sign‑up, single‑event focus.

competitors.name: Meetup.com
competitors.difference: Subscription model, broader community focus; we target a single local event with no recurring fees.

competitors.name: Google Forms RSVP templates
competitors.difference: No capacity enforcement or waitlist automation; our UI handles those automatically.

features: Create an event with title, description, date, time, location and capacity
RSVP form with name and email validation
Automatic waitlist when capacity is reached
LocalStorage persistence – data survives page reloads and works offline
Responsive design for phones and desktops
Accessible form fields and keyboard navigation

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a paid custom‑branding package ($5 per event) for groups that want their own logo/color scheme, while the core RSVP remains free.
monetization.free_tier: Unlimited free events with default styling, no branding, no ads.

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Publish the repo on GitHub, enable GitHub Pages, and share the link in local HOA newsletters and community Facebook groups.
Collect feedback from 3 pilot events and iterate on UI before announcing the branding add‑on.

marketing_content.tagline: One‑click RSVP for neighborhood events – free, fast, no fees.
marketing_content.social_post: 🚀 Launching MicroEvent RSVP – a zero‑cost, no‑login web page for your next block party, club meetup, or community workshop. Set capacity, collect RSVPs, and manage waitlists instantly. Try it now at https://yourusername.github.io/microevent-rsvp

tests: Open the site, fill in the event creation form, submit – the event card appears with correct details.
Add 5 RSVPs to an event with capacity 3 – first 3 appear as confirmed, last 2 appear in the waitlist section.
Refresh the page – all data (event and RSVPs) persists.
next_improvements: Add optional email notification using a third‑party mailto link or Zapier integration.
Support multiple events per site with a simple navigation menu.
